### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | No Healthcare-journal-specific AI page was reachable this session (instructions page returned 403), so this reflects MDPI's publisher-wide policy applied by inference. FACT: MDPI's updated guidelines state LLM tools (e.g. ChatGPT) do not meet authorship criteria and cannot be listed as authors. FACT: if generative AI is used to generate any part of the manuscript, authors must disclose this in Acknowledgments and give a detailed explanation in Materials & Methods. FACT: authors remain fully responsible for originality/validity/integrity of AI-assisted content. Use is permitted subject to mandatory disclosure (not banned, not unrestricted), hence 'conditional' gate and mid-range leniency. |
| **Source URL** | https://www.mdpi.com/about/announcements/5687 |

**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** As of the 2025 'Healthcare Reloaded' aims-and-scope revision (journal's own PMC-hosted announcement), the journal groups submissions into 12 sections (e.g. Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Chronic Care and Palliative Care, Clinical and Digital Health Technologies, Healthcare Quality/Patient Safety/Self-care Management, Mental Health and Psychosocial Well-being, Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Women's and Children's Health, Healthcare Organizations/Systems/Providers) and now explicitly prioritizes work tied to real-world clinical/system outcomes, healthcare management, health informatics, and health policy over purely theoretical or instrument-validation work.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** AI/ML applications in healthcare (dedicated section + active special issue CFP on LLMs/ChatGPT in healthcare), Health informatics / digital health technologies, Health policy and health services research, Real-world clinical/observational studies with measured outcomes, Public health and preventive medicine, Mental health and psychosocial well-being research, Chronic care, palliative care, patient safety and quality improvement studies

### Reviewer Pool Characteristics

Sparse, mixed, low-confidence. fabiaoji.com aggregator describes reviewers giving 'major revision' decisions but with feedback described as less detailed than at higher-tier journals. A Zhihu first-hand post describes one manuscript receiving 40 line-item revision comments from 3 reviewers, suggesting some reviewers engage substantively. No Reddit r/AskAcademia thread specific to this journal was found. Not enough independent corroboration for a confident general reviewer-culture narrative.

- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: No SciRev entry exists for 'Healthcare' (MDPI) (direct scirev.org URL attempt returned 404, no search hits), and no forum post gave a numeric desk-reject percentage specific to this journal — only anecdotal individual outcomes were found.
- **experiential.review_time_months (precise current figure)**: The most journal-specific number (20 days to first decision) is from a 2018 MDPI self-published editorial note, now 7+ years old; the more recent Zhihu-cited figures (20.3 days, 27-36 days to acceptance) are secondhand/aggregator claims without a traceable primary source, so no current, verified figure could be confirmed.
- **peer_review.type (Healthcare-specific confirmation)**: Confirmed only via general MDPI editorial-process page and secondary summaries; Healthcare's own instructions-for-authors page (which would state this explicitly for the journal) was not directly fetchable (403 error), and the Browser tool was unavailable this session to work around it.
